intro.subtitle: WHO AM I?
intro.paragraph1: Full-Stack Developer with 5 years of experience, I have had the opportunity to work on projects involving a wide range of challenges, from application development and security to cloud technologies, modernization and the evolution of existing solutions.
intro.paragraph2: This diversity is what drives me: discovering new environments, understanding their challenges and building appropriate solutions. Curious, versatile and autonomous, I particularly enjoy projects that push me to learn, adapt and take on new technical challenges.

motivation.title: WHAT DRIVES ME
motivation.paragraph1: I enjoy building solutions that have a real impact and working on challenges that allow me to continuously expand my knowledge.
motivation.paragraph2: Continuous learning plays an important role in my career: discovering new technologies, deepening my skills and stepping outside my comfort zone are part of what motivates me every day.
motivation.paragraph3: One of my next goals is to earn the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification to strengthen and validate my knowledge of cloud technologies.

projects.description: Discover a selection of projects I have had the opportunity to work on. Different environments and challenges that have allowed me to develop my versatility and continuously expand my skills.

sncf.title: SNCF
sncf.description: Development and modernization of large-scale HR applications used by several hundred thousand users. Migration to AWS, management of technical obsolescence and improvement of access security.

dgac.title: DGAC
dgac.description: Implementation and standardization of project management rules, quotation reviews and continuous improvement of overall code quality using SonarQube.

agriculture.title: MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE
agriculture.description: Implementation of data import batch processes, orthophoto management and overall code improvements on business applications.
